applicability: Requirement-to-test traceability coverage percentage against a declared minimum acceptance threshold
assumptions: each declared traceability link genuinely and correctly connects a requirement to a test that exercises it
the total requirement count is complete and current
excluded: verification that covered tests currently pass
uncertainty: Standard, widely-used requirements-engineering coverage metric; hand-verified before use (85/100 -> 85.0%; 40/100 -> 40.0%).
limits_policy: Coverage below the declared minimum is flagged rather than accepted.
